flags.name: zmx_abi_contract_version
flags.description: ZMX ABI contract version. Increment on ABI-breaking changes. Must match contracts/runtime/zig_abi_contract_v1.json 'version' field.

flags.name: parse_model_suffixes_enabled
flags.description: Enable PyO3 Rust-backed model suffix parser. False falls back to Python. Feature is always compiled in; this flag documents the intent for routing layer.

flags.name: zmx_native_ffi
flags.description: Cargo feature 'zmx-native': enables C ABI FFI linking against libzmx. Default off; subprocess fallback used when off. Set to true only in environments with libzmx installed.
